content.title: How to watch Howard vs UMBC with Sling TV
content.text: #16 Howard and #16 UMBC meet at the UD Arena for a high-stakes First Four® matchup. The veteran guard has been the steady hand for the Bison, providing essential perimeter scoring and leadership during their late-season conference run.● The X-Factor: Postseason Experience. A dynamic playmaker who has led UMBC's high-tempo offense throughout the season, serving as their primary offensive engine.● The Upset Formula: Three-Point Variance.
